## Ajax 3x3x3 Newcomers Series

One day, three competitions! We are running this one-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 40% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2024** near the bottom of this page for more information).

You can choose between [Ajax 3x3x3 Newcomers A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax3x3x3NewcomersA2024), [Ajax 3x3x3 Newcomers B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax3x3x3NewcomersB2024) or [Ajax 3x3x3 Newcomers C](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax3x3x3NewcomersC2024)! These competitions are identical except for the time of day they take place (morning, afternoon or evening).

You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these three competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors.

### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Newcomers Costa Rica 2024

venue.name: [Paseo Metrópoli](https://paseometropoli.com/web/)
venue.address: Radial de entrada a, Ruta Nacional Primaria 10, Provincia de Cartago, Cartago

items.information:
**Newcomers Costa Rica 2024** 

Es la segunda competencia del nuevo año 2024.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia official de la World Cube Association.
La competencia es abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, el registro esta habilitado desde la página oficial de la WCA. No es necesario tener experiencia, pero los competidores deben estar conocer los Reglamentos
El acceso a invitados y espectadores será gratuita.

Esta competencia participa en el Mes oficial de recién llegados de la WCA 2024. El proceso de registro dará prioridad a los nuevos competidores para el registro, y los competidores que regresen serán aceptados después. Se considera que los nuevos competidores no tienen ID de la WCA o tienen una ID de la WCA de 2024. Se considera que los competidores que regresan tienen una ID de la WCA de 2023 o anterior. Todos los competidores aún deben seguir todos los requisitos de registro para que su registro se considere completo.

Los competidores que ya han competido se pueden registrar en cualquier momento durante el período de registro, pero su registro será aceptado según lo siguiente :

* El primer 50% de las plazas, según lo definido por el límite de competidores, está reservado para nuevos competidores. 
*  Si el 50% de los lugares están ocupados por nuevos competidores, los competidores que regresan serán aceptados por orden de llegada. 
* Si el 50% de los lugares no están ocupados por nuevos competidores antes del cierre de registro dos semanas antes de la competencia, se aceptarán los lugares restantes, hasta el límite de competidores, de los competidores registrados que regresan.


_____
**English version**

**Newcomers Costa Rica 2024

Is a second competition of the new year 2024. 

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition.
The competition is open to all competitors of all nationalities. Registration is available on the WCA website. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA Regulations
The competition is free to spectators and guests.

This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:
The first 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
If 50% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis.
If 50% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.
